By accepting these terms, you acknowledge that you are participating in a confidential beta testing program and agree to provide feedback while maintaining strict confidentiality regarding all aspects of the application, its features, functionality, design, user interface, algorithms, and underlying technology.

terms.ndaBullet1: You will not disclose, discuss, or share any information about Alexandria with any third parties

terms.ndaBullet3: You will not reverse engineer, decompile, or attempt to extract source code or proprietary algorithms
terms.ndaBullet4: You will immediately report any security vulnerabilities or bugs through official channels only
terms.ipContent: Alexandria and all its components, including but not limited to software code, algorithms, user interface designs, content generation systems, quiz formats, educational methodologies, branding, and associated technologies are the exclusive intellectual property of Alexandria's creators and are protected by copyright, trademark, and trade secret laws.
terms.ipBullet1: You acknowledge that Alexandria contains proprietary and confidential information
terms.ipBullet2: You will not attempt to copy, replicate, or create derivative works based on Alexandria
terms.ipBullet3: You will not use any information gained from Alexandria to develop competing products or services
terms.ipBullet4: All feedback and suggestions you provide become the intellectual property of Alexandria's creators
terms.nonCompeteContent: During your participation in the beta testing program and for a period of 2 years thereafter, you agree not to engage in activities that directly compete with Alexandria's educational technology services.
terms.nonCompeteBullet1: You will not develop, create, or participate in the development of educational quiz generation platforms
terms.nonCompeteBullet2: You will not work for or consult with direct competitors in the AI-powered educational technology space
terms.nonCompeteBullet3: You will not use insights gained from Alexandria to benefit competing educational technology ventures
terms.privacyContent: Your personal information and usage data will be collected and processed in accordance with our Privacy Policy. By participating in beta testing, you consent to the collection of detailed usage analytics, performance metrics, and feedback data to improve Alexandria's functionality and user experience.
terms.liabilityContent: Alexandria is provided 'as-is' during beta testing. The creators of Alexandria shall not be liable for any damages, data loss, or issues arising from your use of the beta application. You acknowledge that beta software may contain bugs, errors, or incomplete features, and you use it at your own risk.
terms.terminationContent: These terms remain in effect until terminated by either party. Alexandria's creators may terminate your beta access at any time without notice. Upon termination, you must immediately cease all use of the application and continue to maintain confidentiality of all proprietary information indefinitely.
terms.contactContent: For questions regarding these terms or to report issues during beta testing, please contact us through official channels only. Do not discuss Alexandria publicly on social media, forums, or other platforms.

quote1.text: The expert in anything was once a beginner.
quote1.author: Helen Hayes

quote2.text: Education is the most powerful weapon which you can use to change the world.
quote2.author: Nelson Mandela

quote3.text: The beautiful thing about learning is that no one can take it away from you.
quote3.author: B.B. King

quote4.text: Success is no accident. It is hard work, perseverance, learning, studying, sacrifice and most of all, love of what you are doing.
quote4.author: Pelé

quote5.text: The capacity to learn is a gift; the ability to learn is a skill; the willingness to learn is a choice.
quote5.author: Brian Herbert

quote6.text: Study hard what interests you the most in the most undisciplined, irreverent and original manner possible.
quote6.author: Richard Feynman

quote7.text: An investment in knowledge pays the best interest.
quote7.author: Benjamin Franklin

quote8.text: The only source of knowledge is experience.
quote8.author: Albert Einstein

quote10.text: Education is not preparation for life; education is life itself.
quote10.author: John Dewey

quote11.text: The more that you read, the more things you will know. The more that you learn, the more places you'll go.
quote11.author: Dr. Seuss
